Name: Animated Ducky Crab Pots
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
[b][size=4][color=#c9daf8]Features ✧ °｡⋆✦･ﾟ ✧[/color][/size][/b]
Your crab pots have been transformed!

Add more ducks to your farm decoration with this animated duck mod, which converts crab pots into ducks with four different color options:
[list]
[*]Mallard 💚[/*]
[*]White 🤍[/*]
[*]Rubber Ducky 💛[/*]
[*]Swedish Blue 💙[/*]
[/list]
Now with a Seagull option when you're on the beach!

Alternative Textures and Content Patcher options available. You can even use both at once -- Content Patcher to set your default and Alternative Textures to add variety!

[b][size=3]✧ Alternative Textures ✧ [/size][/b]
Each duck features animation and can face either right or left, adding a dynamic look to your setup.
To customize the appearance of your crab pots with birds, use the Paint Bucket tool, available for purchase from Robin.
This tool allows you to switch between the color, bird, and directions options to mix-and-match easily. 

[b][size=3]✧ Content Patcher ✧ [/size][/b]
Select duck type by editing the config.json created by the mod after you run it the firtst time or immediately from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Manager[/url] (recommended). 
Mallard (green head with brown body) is the default, with Seagull appearing on beaches. Duck type can be changed, and seagull can be disabled as desired. 

[b][size=3]✧ Configuration ✧ [/size][/b]
[spoiler]
Edit the config.json using the text editor of your choice, or by accessing it in-game via Generic Mod Config Manager (recommended).
Default settings:
[code]{
"Color": "SwedishDuck", // MallardDuck, YellowDuck, WhiteDuck, SwedishDuck
"EnableSeagulls": "true" // true, false
}[/code][/spoiler]

Stay ducky my friends! 🦆🦆🦆🦆🦆🦆🦆🦆🦆🦆
